evidence: attempt-08.jsonl turn 34 reports RMSE 0.913968 and a 2.72 MB pickle from Dataset.load_from_df; replaying that approach reproduces those values, while the seed verifier reports RMSE 1.1303. tests/test_outputs.py loads its test set through Dataset.load_from_file without reconciling raw-ID types.
change: Normalize held-out raw user and item IDs to the trained model's raw-ID key types before prediction, preserving the same records and split while accepting both documented CSV-loading approaches.
